title: The Stability Delusion
hook: Your "stable" 9-to-5 is actually the riskiest investment you're making.
script:
(Visual: Split screen. Left side shows a secure office cubicle. Right side shows a diversified portfolio of skills/income.)

"Most Indian professionals confuse 'stability' with 'predictability.' 

You think you're safe because your salary hits on the 1st of every month. But in reality, you've created a single point of failure. 

If one person—your boss or a board member—decides you're no longer needed, your income drops to zero instantly. 

True stability isn't a steady paycheck from one source; it’s the ability to generate value independently of any single employer. 

You aren't buying security; you're paying a premium to ignore your own fragility."
caption: Stability is a feeling, not a financial fact. When you rely on a single source of income, you aren't stable—you're dependent. Stop optimizing for a steady paycheck and start optimizing for market relevance. #RationalThoughts #CareerStrategy #FirstPrinciples #IndianProfessionals
